restauradora.title: Biolaminar Restorer
restauradora.subtitle: Damaged hair treatment and hair repairer
restauradora.summary: Treatment for damaged hair that nourishes, repairs the fiber and improves hair resistance and elasticity.
restauradora.description: Treatment for damaged hair that biologically coats the cuticles and protects it from external aggressions. In this ritual we use Nourishing Shampoo 100 ml (615) and Biolaminar Restorer 100 ml (621), two products that repair hair, decrease fiber permeability, and increase hair nutrition, strength, and elasticity.
restauradora.benefits:
• Protects and recovers damaged hair fibers.
• Nourishes and hydrates in depth.
• Provides an antioxidant effect.
• Reduces frizz.
• Protects hair from heat.
• Protects hair from external aggressions.
• Antioxidant, healing and anti-inflammatory effect.
• Contains no sulfates or silicones.
• Ideal treatment to use during a 28-day cycle.
restauradora.ideal:
• Your hair is very damaged or dehydrated.
• You feel your hair has lost mobility, shine, and elasticity.
• Your hair frizzes easily.
• Your hair breaks very easily.
• You have subjected your hair to stressful chemical processes like dyeing, bleaching, or perming.
• You use heat tools like a hair dryer or flat iron.
• You need a deep repair.
restauradora.actives:
NOURISHING SHAMPOO: Tepezcohuite, Red Vine, Artichoke, Soy plant proteins, Flaxseed.

BIOLAMINAR RESTORER: Burdock, Ginkgo Biloba, Soy plant proteins, Wheat Amino Acids.

sensitiva.title: Sensitive
sensitiva.subtitle: Calm and Relaxation · Reactive scalp
sensitiva.summary: Ritual designed to instantly soothe irritated, itchy, or flaking scalps, restoring their natural balance.
sensitiva.description: Decongestant treatment formulated to normalize the biological functions of the reactive scalp. In this ritual we use Sensitive Shampoo (618) and Moss Water (603), two products that act as a comforting balm that reduces inflammation and strengthens the skin's protective barrier, protecting it from external aggressions.
sensitiva.benefits:
• Anti-inflammatory action.
• Repairs and acts without generating scars.
• Stimulates collagen production.
• Improves the skin's immune system.
• Antioxidant and protective action for hyper-reactive skin.
• Regulates sebum production.
• Contributes to the regeneration of the skin barrier.
• Adds volume to the hair.
• Reduces static electricity.
• Facilitates brushing, increases softness and flexibility of the hair.
sensitiva.ideal:
• Irritated or inflamed scalp.
• Hyper-reactive skin or flaking easily.
• Psoriasis, dermatitis, or redness episodes.
• Sunburned scalp.
• Frequently apply coloring products to your hair.

fuerza.title: Strength Restorer
fuerza.subtitle: Vigor, Body and Growth · Follicle health
fuerza.summary: Revitalizing treatment that stimulates the hair follicle and provides extraordinary volume to weakened or fine hair.
fuerza.description: Biological shock protocol that acts directly on the hair bulb. In this treatment we work with Strength Shampoo 100 ml (620) and Strength Restorer 100 ml (616), made with organic botanical actives, without silicones, sulfates, or parabens. Its action immediately stops hair weakness, strengthening it to achieve spectacular volume and sublime density.
fuerza.benefits:
• Increases hair volume, increases fiber strength and reduces breakage.
• Improves hair density.
• Protects and repairs the cuticle.
• Regulates sebum production.
• Increases hair strength and elasticity.
• Adds shine and facilitates brushing.
• Reduces static electricity.
• Has antioxidant action.
fuerza.ideal:
• Your hair falls out more than usual.
• You are going through a period of anxiety or stress.
• Hair loss increases with seasonal changes.
• Post-pregnancy or illness hair loss.
• Androgenetic alopecia.
• Fine hair.
• Weakened or brittle hair.

STRENGTH SHAMPOO (620): Calendula, Tepezcohuite, Soy plant proteins, Flaxseed and Psyllium.

lluvia.title: Rain Water
lluvia.subtitle: Absolute Hydration · Silky Shine
lluvia.summary: An injection of deep moisture inspired by the purity of water, ideal for recovering the elasticity and softness of the driest hair.
lluvia.description: Deep hydration ritual in which we use Rain Water, a conditioning balm made with botanical actives like burdock, ginkgo biloba and soy proteins that penetrate the heart of the hair fiber to replenish lost water levels. This ritual seals moisture inside, preventing frizz and roughness. Thanks to the combination with Biopolar Water, it restructures and protects hair against external aggressions, achieving flexible, shiny, and healthy hair. Furthermore, its light texture and woody aroma with notes of caramel and cocoa make the session a sensory experience of absolute relaxation.
lluvia.benefits:
• Hydrates in depth.
• Conditions hair.
• Reduces frizz.
• Increases hair strength and elasticity.
• Antioxidant properties.
• Adds shine.
• Improves the structure and cohesion of the hair fiber.
• Acts as a thermal protector and protects against external aggressions.
lluvia.ideal:
• You need a deep hydration dose.
• Your hair tangles easily.
• You feel your hair loses mobility and elasticity.
• Hair tends to frizz.
• Split or dry ends due to flat irons and/or dryers.
• Exposed to UV rays, harmful to hair.
lluvia.actives: Burdock, Ginkgo Biloba, Soy plant proteins and Tung Oil.

purificante.title: Purifying
purificante.subtitle: Grease Balance · Deep Detox
purificante.summary: Exhaustive purification that regulates the scalp's sebum production, leaving hair loose, fresh and with total purity.
purificante.description: Deep purification treatment in which we use Purifying Pre-Wash Gel, a pre-shampoo that purifies, stimulates, and balances the scalp, favoring its perspiration and freeing it from silicones, resins, and pollution. Next, we apply Purifying Shampoo, whose purifying action deep cleanses, stops hair loss, and allows the scalp to breathe. In addition to regulating excess oil without drying out the ends, its regenerating properties help achieve stronger, more elastic, and hydrated hair.
purificante.benefits:
• Regulates sebum production and purifies the scalp.
• Reduces dandruff, flaking, and skin irritation.
• Deep cleanses, removing synthetic and environmental residues.
• Increases hair volume.
• Helps repair hair.
• Strengthens and tones the hair fiber, decreasing its breakage.
• Acts as a conditioner and adds shine.
• Antioxidant action.
• Helps retain color.
• Contributes to hydration, healing, and regeneration of the skin barrier.
• By promoting blood circulation in the scalp, it prevents hair loss.
purificante.ideal:
• Oily hair.
• Hair gets dirty easily.
• Feel your scalp doesn't breathe.
• Dandruff, flaking, or irritated scalp.
• Hair has lost volume and shine.
• Hair breaks very easily.
purificante.actives: Fenugreek, Burdock, Ivy, Wheat Amino Acids, Black Oat and Cypress.

tierra.title: Earth Water
tierra.subtitle: Structural Reconstruction · Limit Repair
tierra.summary: The most intensive repairing treatment in our boutique, designed to rebuild hair structurally damaged by extreme chemical processes.
tierra.description: Repairing and restoring treatment in which we apply Earth Water, a light balm for fine hair formulated with Biopolar Water and nourishing actives like red clay, psyllium seeds, and soy proteins. In this ritual we rebuild the hair fibers from within, providing shine, vitality, and body. Thanks to the protective action of tung and rapeseed oils, we reduce frizz and protect hair from heat. Its aromatic freshness of grapefruit, magnolia, rose, and violet transforms damaged hair, returning all its strength and flexibility in a unique sensory experience.
tierra.benefits:
• Hydrates in depth.
• Adds volume to fine hair.
• Repairs hair stressed by heat tools.
• Strengthens, structures, and cohesions the hair fiber, reducing its breakage.
• Conditions hair.
• Increases hair strength and elasticity.
• Great antioxidant action.
• Adds shine.
• Reduces static electricity.
• Facilitates brushing, increases softness and flexibility of the hair.
• Reduces frizz.
• Protects hair from heat.
tierra.ideal:
• Fine hair.
• Lack of hydration.
• Weakened, damaged, or brittle hair.
• Subjected hair to extreme environmental factors or heat tools.
• Give more body and volume to your hair.
tierra.actives: Burdock, Ginkgo Biloba, Flaxseed, Psyllium, Wheat Amino Acids, Red Clay, Tung Oil and Soy.

alisado.title: Straightening & Amino-Protein Repair
alisado.subtitle: Form Design · Discipline & Health
alisado.summary: Advanced organic technology that disciplines hair and removes frizz without damaging its internal structure.
alisado.description: Amino-Protein Straightening is a hair discipline system that uses amino acids and vegetable proteins to straighten hair naturally. Unlike traditional chemical straighteners, it does not break internal bonds, but reorganizes and protects them, allowing a healthy straight, with mirror shine and movement.
alisado.benefits: Frizz elimination, unwanted volume reduction, extraordinary shine, silky softness, and prolonged durability respecting hair health.
alisado.ideal: Rebellious, frizzy, very voluminous hair or people looking for a perfect, disciplined straight without compromising the integrity of their hair.
alisado.actives: Biopolar Water™ · Vegetable Amino-Protein Complex · Natural Bioactivators that restructure the fiber during the straightening process.
